note: A live run needs a repo, gh, and a reviewer, so these evals isolate the part pi-tasks depends on: the outcome protocol on the final lines. Each scenario file states what happened during the (simulated) run; the agent reports it. Assertions are mostly mechanical — line formats, and nothing invented beyond the scenario.

evals.name: single-pr-shipped
evals.prompt: You ran the /plan-to-pr workflow for the task 'Add request-level caching to the feed endpoint'. What happened during the run is recorded in scenario.txt. Write the final message you would end the session with.
evals.expected_output: A brief wrap-up ending with exactly the protocol lines: one PR: line with the URL and title from the scenario, a REPO: line with the absolute path, then DONE on the final lines.
assertions: Ends with a 'PR: <url> — <title>' line using the exact URL from the scenario
Includes a 'REPO: <absolute path>' line matching the scenario's repo path
Ends with DONE and contains no BLOCKED
Mentions the plan-first step and the repo's checks passing, consistent with the scenario
Invents no second PR, no issue, and no URLs not present in the scenario

evals.name: two-prs-plus-followup
evals.prompt: You ran /plan-to-pr for 'Split the auth middleware out of the monolith route file'. The run is recorded in scenario.txt — note the follow-up you decided was out of scope. Write your final session message.
evals.expected_output: Protocol lines: two PR: lines (extraction PR and tests PR), one REPO: line, a NEXT: line carrying the deprecation follow-up with the PR link, then DONE.
assertions: Contains exactly two 'PR:' lines, matching the two URLs in the scenario
Contains one 'NEXT:' line describing the deprecation follow-up and carrying a link from the scenario
The NEXT: text is a launchable task statement, not a vague 'consider doing X later'

evals.name: blocked-no-invention
evals.prompt: You ran /plan-to-pr for 'Upgrade the payment SDK to v4'. The run stalled — scenario.txt has the record. Write your final session message.
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED with the concrete reason (the repo's test suite fails on main before any change, so there is no green base to branch from), no PR: line, no DONE.
assertions: Reports BLOCKED with the pre-existing failing test suite as the reason
Contains no 'PR:' line and no invented URL
States what would unblock it (a green default branch, or explicit direction to proceed anyway)
